## Builder 1 note

What exists now (rows 3, 4 and 6 of the table are built; T-513 pending):

- "Show as" on the person's record in Admin → People: its own panel (`#show-as`), the three
  choices and a reason that must be chosen from the fixed list, then "Save Show as"
  (`apps/web/src/features/people-area/name-request-form.tsx`, `setNameRequestAction` in
  `actions.ts`). It runs the existing command `people.set_name_request` (admin or registrar,
  context from the session); nothing new in core. Saved, the panel says so once.
- In an archived or suspended league a change that shows more is refused with "This league is
  archived, so this setting can only be changed to show less." (`name-request.ts`,
  `nameRequestRefusalCode`; messages in `error.ts`).
- "Show as: initials" / "Show as: removed" beside the recorded name on each Admin → Teams roster
  line, the People list and the bin (`showAsOf` in `teams-area/roster-name.ts`). The roster
  read (`list-roster.ts`) and the bin read (`list-binned.ts`) now carry `people.visibility`;
  the stand-ins likewise. No migration.
- Tests: `apps/web/src/features/people-area/name-request.test.ts` (9) and one database case in
  `packages/database/src/stores/people-commands.test.ts`. Each was broken by hand (refusal
  code, `showAsOf`, both reads): 5 failed, then passed again once restored.
- Run and passed: `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck`, the messages tests, the pending
  decisions test, the people, teams and bin feature tests, `stand-in-world-bin`, and the
  database `people-commands`, `bin-commands` and `rosters-commands` tests. Not run (stopped at
  the command limit): `node scripts/fence-filter-check.mjs` for the two changed queries, and
  the core teams, leagues and people suites.

What is left, by layer (the table's rows):

- Builder 2: rows 11 to 14 (statistics rows carry the jersey number; "#12" with the team under
  Hidden and for S-34; the roster under Hidden prints the number once), 16 to 20, 22, 24 to 27.
- Builder 3: the browser proof, rows 5, 10, 28 to 30, in both made-up leagues, including the new
  panel: set "removed" in Admin → People, then the roster, statistics, game page and snapshot.
- Item 4 of this brief needed no code: the public rosters, statistics, game page and snapshot
  already read people through `showName` (rows 7 to 9); only the browser proof is missing.

What I distrust:

- The form offers all three choices in an archived league and lets the refusal explain; a
  design review may want the choices that show more left out there.
- Nothing checks the new panel in a browser yet, nor that a scorekeeper never sees it (the
  People area's gate should keep them out; not seen).

## Builder 2 note

What exists now (rows 11 to 14, 18, 25 and 26 built; builder 1's distrust of the archived form mended; S-134, S-135 pending, T-513 extended):

- The statistics row carries the jersey number: `list-player-team-links.ts` (and its stand-in) gives each link the roster place's number, a current place's first; no migration. Core's `numberInPlace` (`people/rules/show-name.ts`) is the one rule: a number only for a name `showName` hid as `hidden` or `no_name`, never for `removed` or `restricted`. `statisticsSource` puts it on `PlayerName.number`; the web words it once (`playerNameText` in `stats-pages/build-stats.ts`) for the statistics page, the leaders and the team page's statistics: "#12", with the team in its own column or detail.
- The roster prints the number once: the number column keeps it and the name reads "Name not shown" (S-134; P6 R-24 corrected).
- In an archived or suspended league "Show as" offers only the request kept now and the choices that show less (`showAsChoicesFor`, `people-area/name-request.ts`); the command's refusal stays the guard.
- League settings → Privacy: "To show less of one person, open their record in People and choose "Show as"", always; where adults show in full and children do not, that the day a name turns full tells an 18th birthday; in an adult league with children, that the names tell who is a child (S-135, P6).
- Run and passed: `node scripts/fence-filter-check.mjs list-roster list-binned` (7 filters, 0 problems) and `list-player-team-links` (2, 0; the count did not move), the core teams, leagues and people suites (635), core standings and people, stats-pages, team-pages, people-area, settings-area, the messages tests, `database-names-scan` and `database-first-child` on the database, the public-reads isolation cases, the pending-decisions test, `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck`. Each new test was broken by hand once (`numberInPlace`, the roster name, `showAsChoicesFor`, the birthday note): each failed, then passed once restored.
- `database-names-scan.test.ts` now expects "#{4 + place}" under Hidden on the statistics and leaders, from the seed's numbers.

Left for builder 3 (besides the browser proof, rows 5, 10, 28 to 30):

- Row 20: who gave the parents' confirmation beside "Confirmed on" (needs a read of the activity log: a new read, its role-matrix row and `activity-messages.test.ts`).
- Row 17: the warning when a whole name is typed into the first-name box; the "this makes them 114: is that right?" question (check `age-on-record.ts:54`, it may already ask); row 19: a player typed in at the scorer's table with no age shown as a child (touches `insert-table-player.ts` and maybe `games-area`, lane 2.253's); row 22: the ticked-and-18 finder; row 16 (confirm box only under Full names); rows 24 and 27 (wider R-28 scan; the two T-81 scans with dates).
- The browser proof should see "#12" on the statistics under Hidden and the number once on the roster.

What I distrust:

- `PlayerName.hiddenBecause` still words a hidden name as `removed` (as before); only `number` tells them apart. A reader that ignores `number` falls back to the nameless words, never to a name.
- Two current roster places of one person on one team pick a number by text order (`max`): rare, but not the "right" one.
- The roster choice (S-134) is a design call; the other way is one line in `build-team.ts`.
